title: OneCLI – OSS credential gateway that keeps secrets out of AI agents
claim: Show HN: OneCLI – OSS credential gateway that keeps secrets out of AI agents
why_good: An OSS credential gateway that keeps secrets out of AI agents — a real, timely security need as agents touch more systems.
value: Sell a team/enterprise tier (audit, rotation, policy) to orgs deploying agents with access to real credentials.
risk: Secrets management is crowded (Vault, Infisical, Doppler); the 'for agents' angle must become a distinct, trusted product.

zh.claim: Show HN: OneCLI —— 让密钥不进入 AI agent 的开源凭证网关。
zh.why_good: 一个让密钥不进入 AI agent 的开源凭证网关——随着 agent 接触更多系统,这是真实且及时的安全需求。
zh.value: 给让 agent 接触真实凭证的组织卖团队/企业版(审计、轮换、策略)。
zh.risk: 密钥管理很挤(Vault、Infisical、Doppler);为 agent 的角度必须变成独立、被信任的产品。
